title: Ep 27 — OpenAI's first 'critical'-threshold hacking model, and the AI wingman clearing half a million dollars a month
description: OpenAI's Astra becomes the first model to cross a 'critical' cybersecurity capability threshold, while Anthropic's new Fable and Mythos models cut agentic AI costs by up to 45%. Plus a deep dive on Rizz, the AI dating-reply app pulling in $500k a month, and what its screenshot-to-persuasive-text mechanic could mean for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships.
